title: SourceSnapshot
description: Content-addressed capture of one spec Source. Field names match bicameral_api::source::SourceSnapshot, plus required source_uri. source_uri is the Source uri, not the address of these bytes. Factory #935 E1. ADR-0033.

snapshot_ref.description: Existing snapshot_ref on SourceSnapshot. Not a branch identity.

content_hash.description: Identity of the captured bytes. SHA-256 of the canonical snapshot representation.

source_uri.description: Same string as Source.uri. Back-pointer only.
